[[Andorra]] competed at the [[2026 Winter Olympics]] in [[Milan]] and [[Cortina d'Ampezzo]], Italy, from 6 to 22 February 2026.

Three Andorran athletes [[Joan Verdú (alpine skier)|Joan Verdú]], [[Cande Moreno]] and [[Irineu Esteve]] were the country's flagbearer during the [[2026 Winter Olympics opening ceremony|opening ceremony]].<ref>{{cite news|date=6 February 2026|url=https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/news/all-flagbearers-named-for-milano-cortina-2026-opening-ceremony|title=Milano Cortina 2026 Opening Ceremony: All Flagbearers, all nations - complete list|access-date=16 February 2026|publisher=[[International Olympic Committee]]|work=Olympics.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Roche|first=Calum|date=6 February 2026|title=2026 Winter Olympics opening ceremony: order and flag bearers by country|url=https://en.as.com/olympic_games/2026-winter-olympics-opening-ceremony-order-and-flag-bearers-by-country-f202602-n/|work=[[Diario AS]]|location=Madrid, Spain|access-date=16 February 2026}}</ref> Meanwhile, a volunteer was the country's flagbearer during the [[2026 Winter Olympics closing ceremony|closing ceremony]].<ref>{{cite news|date=22 February 2026|url=https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/news/all-flagbearers-named-for-milano-cortina-2026-closing-ceremony|title=Milano Cortina 2026 Closing Ceremony: full list of flagbearers for every nation|access-date=22 February 2026|publisher=[[International Olympic Committee]]|work=Olympics.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last2=Bowers|first2=Rachel G|last1=Moore|first1=Casey L.|date=22 February 2026|title=Olympics closing ceremony highlights: Milano Cortina Games wrap up in style|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/olympics/2026/02/22/olympics-closing-ceremony-live-updates/88799693007/|work=[[USA Today]]|location=New York City, New York, USA|access-date=22 February 2026}}</ref>

==Cross-country skiing==
{{main|Cross-country skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics|Cross-country skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Qualification}}
